models.name: GPT-6.1 Terra
models.notes: Tool calling requires the Responses API; Chat Completions support does not imply tool support on that endpoint. Cache-write price uses 30-minute retention; 12-hour retention costs $2.50/MTok. Above 272K input tokens, the full request uses 2x input/cache rates and 1.5x output rates. Batch/Flex are 50% below Standard; Fast mode is 2x Standard; regional processing adds 10% where available.
